author: Andrew Fisher

waiverRow.what: on the hire only — never on labour, steps, cleaning, install, demob or pump-outs (the card’s rule)
waiverRow.basis: not on the 2026 contracts yet — the branch’s rate

existingApp.finding: No separate damage waiver percentage or amount is currently added by the app.

notes: Street Rate Card 2026 A2: Prices Exclude GST and Damage waiver
A3: no waiver on labour, steps, fire extinguishers, cleaning, installation and demobilisation, pump outs

boq.exceptions: GN20 350 kVA daily and standby differ from the current next-lower 315 kVA source basis. BOQ quantities also use different full/standby days. 60 kVA daily rate differs by one cent from applying 12.5% to the raw card precision.

conclusion: Higher BOQ values show hire and service uplifts, plus different day quantities and packaged service/transport lines. Their commercial reason is not labelled, so this does not establish damage waiver or a 25% rule. Do not layer another percentage over them.
